abilities.name: Basic Attack
abilities.description: Deals damage to a single enemy

abilities.name: Cleave
abilities.description: Deals full damage to all frontline enemies. If no frontline enemies, hits all backline enemies instead

abilities.name: Heal
abilities.description: Heals a single ally based on heal_value

abilities.name: Group Heal
abilities.description: Heals all allies based on heal_value

abilities.name: Poison Strike
abilities.description: Applies poison stacks to a single enemy

abilities.name: Quicken
abilities.description: Applies haste to self, doubling cooldown tick rate

abilities.name: Quicken Ally
abilities.description: Applies haste to the nearest ally, doubling their cooldown tick rate

abilities.name: Shield Self
abilities.description: Applies shield to self, absorbing incoming attack damage

abilities.name: Shield Ally
abilities.description: Applies shield to the nearest ally, absorbing incoming attack damage

abilities.name: Slow Enemy
abilities.description: Applies slow to a single enemy, halving their cooldown tick rate

abilities.name: Slow Enemy Row
abilities.description: Applies slow to all enemies in the nearest row, halving their cooldown tick rate

abilities.name: Slow All Enemies
abilities.description: Applies slow to all enemies, halving their cooldown tick rate

abilities.name: Haste Ally Row
abilities.description: Applies haste to all allies in the nearest row, doubling their cooldown tick rate

abilities.name: Haste All Allies
abilities.description: Applies haste to all allies, doubling their cooldown tick rate
